@Roth.indexSet_bddAbove : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (B : ℝ) (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  BddAbove (Roth.indexSet B q r)

theorem Roth.indexSet_bddAbove.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (B : ℝ) (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  BddAbove (Roth.indexSet B q r) :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] B q {r} ↦
  Exists.intro ↑(Fintype.card σ) fun ⦃a⦄ a_1 ↦
    Exists.casesOn a_1 fun R h ↦
      And.casesOn h fun left right ↦
        And.casesOn left fun hR0 right_1 ↦
          And.casesOn right_1 fun hRd right_2 ↦
            Exists.casesOn right fun h h_1 ↦
              And.casesOn h_1 fun left right ↦
                right ▸
                  Roth.index_le_card
                    ((map_ne_zero_iff (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
                          (map_injective (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Int.cast_injective)).mpr
                      hR0)
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (forall_congr fun j ↦
                          congrFun'
                            (congrArg LE.le
                              (Multiset.count.congr_simp j j (Eq.refl j) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R).degrees R.degrees
                                (degrees_map_of_injective R Int.cast_injective)))
                            (r j)))
                      hRd)
                    fun j ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)

BDDABOVE186_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (B : ℝ) (q : σ → ℕ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  BddAbove (Roth.indexSet B q r)
